messages.subject: Change dBref seawater
parts:
Hi,

I'm working on underwater soundscape and was looking into changing the reference pressure to 1microPa.
The thing is, when I check the help file for the spec function for instance (or even the package vignette), and there is not much information on using other values...

In air, the reference pressure value is 20microPa.

Please forgive the ignorance, but the value recommended for air is 20*10e-5 and if this value is in Pascals it corresponds to 0.002 Pascals, which is 2000 microPa, not 20, right?
I get a bit confused as to how this estimate was done and which units are being used.
If everything is in Pascal, then I should easily use 1*10^-6 but am afraid of trusting values without knowing what is going on with the calculations suggested.


Any help with this would be appreciated.

Cheers,
SA

messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Change dBref seawater
parts:
Hello,

The reference pressure value is indeed 20 microPa = 20*10e-6 Pa = 2*10e-5=0.00002 Pa

So yes you should be able to use 1*10^-6. 

HTH

Jerome
